Reason: The chest X-ray shows complete opacification of the left hemithorax with a marked shift of the mediastinum and trachea to the left, indicating total volume loss consistent with the absence of the left lung. This presentation in an asymptomatic young adult is characteristic of left lung agenesis, where the lung parenchyma and vasculature are completely absent.
